name: All three permission-set email templates are present and enabled in catalog
description:
Objective: All three permission-set email templates are present and enabled in catalog.
Preconditions: Open Permission set emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Permission set emails.
2. All three permission-set email templates are present and enabled in catalog.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Each permission-set event template must be present and enabled in the notification portal template catalog under CRM Backend.
